blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Commission on Elections (Comelec) is targeting an additional three million registered voters ahead of the May 2028 national and local elections as it prepares to open a nine-month voter registration period. Registration will run from Nov. 10, 2026, to July 30, 2027. However, registration in Naga City and Batanes will begin a week after their respective electoral exercises this month, Comelec Chair George Erwin Garcia said. Naga City will hold a plebiscite on Nov. 21 to determine whether it will become a highly urbanized city, while Batanes will hold special elections on Nov. 28 to elect its […]...
